title: Sculptural dunes
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: minimal personal website background, wide 16:9 landscape.
Primary request: an original serene sage-and-cream abstract desert of smooth sculptural sand dunes, with a few flowing ridges that feel like folded paper. No clouds.
Scene/backdrop: pale muted sage atmosphere, almost flat and calm.
Subject: just three or four elegant dune ridges, buttercream highlights rolling into dusty teal shadows.
Style/medium: refined retro digital illustration, fine tiny ASCII-like monospaced glyph marks and ordered dither shading following the dune volumes, soft printed grain, sophisticated restrained palette.
Composition/framing: dunes occupy only the lower third and bottom corners; upper and central 60 percent are very calm nearly flat pale sage negative space suitable behind website copy. A graceful low horizon. Wide 16:9 canvas.
Lighting/mood: diffuse soft light, quiet and airy.
Color palette: muted pale sage, buttercream, dusty teal, low saturation and restrained contrast.
Materials/textures: smooth paper-like sculptural surfaces, tiny precise character-like marks integrated into tonal shading, delicate print texture. Texture much fainter in upper negative space.
Constraints: original artwork; no clouds, no people, no plants, no objects, no words, no readable text, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no border or frame. Avoid busy detail and high contrast in the central content area.
